title: WHEN YOUR AI AGENT SUCCUMBS TO PEER-PRESSURE: STUDYING OPINION-CHANGE DYNAMICS OF LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Embedding LLM agents in simulated social networks and prompting them with varying percentages of peer disagreement to measure the threshold at which they flip their initial binary opinions on topics like green energy and mandatory vaccination.

Evaluating 'persuasion asymmetry' by comparing the level of peer pressure required to shift an agent's stance from affirmative ('Yes') to negative ('No') versus the reverse across different cognitive layers (values, beliefs, attitudes, opinions, intentions).
